name: task_collect
description: Gather the current round's worker reports from the host inbox (waits up to timeout_secs for all workers, returns early when everyone reported). Inactive workers are woken headlessly by default. Each report's STATUS line is folded into its assignment; reports are recorded in the room transcript.

timeout_secs.description: Whole seconds to wait for reports (default 60; values outside 5-600 are rejected). Blocks this long only when workers are slow.

wake.description: Wake inactive workers headlessly before waiting (default true).
